property_summary: For any caller, role and target, renounceRole must revert exactly when the target is not the caller (self-renunciation always succeeds): the inverted check makes the buggy contract revert on self-renunciation and silently succeed when renouncing someone else's role.
change_summary: Invert the equality check so renouncing one's own role reverts while renouncing another account's role succeeds.
